items.title: Onyeka Okongwu gets a runner to go with 10 seconds left and the Hawks survive, 108-104. 45 minutes for Jarace Walker, 41 for Jalen Slawson, 40 for Jay Huff, 42 for second-round rookie Braden Smith in his first NBA start. Six-man rotation nearly got it done.

quote.author: Dan Devine
quote.text: The Pacers have six healthy players, including none of their starters, and they've cut a 15-point Hawks lead to two with 58.7 seconds to go. Hell of an effort by Indiana.

quote.author: Tony East
quote.text:
Braden Smith is hurting. Just stumbled off the court and is reaching for the back of his left leg. Pacers take a timeout and he is the first guy to the bench. But he's standing drunking water now.

Pacers ball, down 2 with under one minute to go.

items.title: Former Sixers Summer League player Jalen Slawson just pulled off a hell of a chase-down block on LeBron James. It was called a foul, but Rick Carlisle challenged and will win. Slawson has really come on for the Pacers on a two-way contract.
